title: Recover text evidence and hand over uncertainty
goal: Independently restore the right report version and reconcile factual records while preserving a wrong-but-valid backup.
challenge: Two known compressed reports are both valid; only one matches the independently retained expected hash. Restore it separately, select the confirmed ERROR records, retain timestamp/context and explain what the report cannot prove. Preserve both candidates and all originals.

steps.command: w=$(mktemp -d "$HOME/textarchive-handover.XXXXXX") && cd "$w" && saved_umask=$(umask) && umask 077 && pwd && here() { case "$w" in "$HOME"/textarchive-handover.??????) ;; *) return 19;; esac; test "${w%/*}" = "$HOME" && test -d "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && test "$(realpath -e "$w")" = "$w" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a "$w")" = learner:700 && test "$(pwd -P)" = "$w"; }; dir_ok() { test -d "$1" && test ! -L "$1" && test "$(realpath -e -- "$1")" = "$w/$1"; }; fresh() { for f; do test ! -e "$f" && test ! -L "$f" || return 19; done; }; here && test "$(df --output=avail -k . | tail -1)" -gt 65536
steps.explanation: Create and record a new private guest workspace. Stop on any failed guard; the free-space check is an observation, not a guaranteed reserve. Do not use the host terminal.
steps.expected: A unique learner-owned mode0700 directory; no originals overwritten.

steps.command:
here && fresh current.txt expected.sha old.txt old.gz accepted.gz accepted.sha restore.txt evidence.txt && printf '2026-10-11T12:00Z host-a INFO ready
2026-10-11T12:01Z host-a ERROR input-missing
' > current.txt && printf '2026-10-10T12:00Z host-a INFO ready
' > old.txt && sha256sum current.txt > expected.sha && gzip -n -c old.txt > old.gz && gzip -n -c current.txt > accepted.gz && sha256sum accepted.gz > accepted.sha
steps.explanation: These are original fictional guest-local records, not live system diagnosis. The expected hash is retained independently of the two compressed candidates.
steps.expected: A current report, older valid report, two distinct compressed candidates and references.

steps.command: here && gzip -t old.gz accepted.gz && { gzip -dc old.gz | cmp -s - current.txt; ps=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}"); test "${ps[0]}" = 0 && test "${ps[1]}" = 1; }
steps.explanation: Both streams pass compression checks, but the older payload fails expected contents. Do not overwrite a reference to make the wrong candidate appear correct.
steps.expected: Wrong selection is demonstrably rejected without altering either candidate.

steps.command: here && sha256sum -c accepted.sha expected.sha && gzip -dc accepted.gz > restore.txt && cmp current.txt restore.txt && grep -E '^[0-9T:Z-]+ host-a ERROR ' restore.txt > evidence.txt && cat evidence.txt
steps.explanation: Choose an equivalent supported filter and verify the exact retained timestamp/host/event. Your interpretation of cause, urgency and next checks is self-reviewed, not keyword-scored.
steps.expected: Only the 12:01 input-missing event, with original context and copies preserved.

hints: Format validity does not select the correct recovery point.
Separate reported error evidence from a causal conclusion.
review: I retained actual statuses, bytes and relevant identities, including the incorrect case; successful command exit alone is not my evidence.
I can explain the stated limitations and independently meet the Challenge outcomes. Completion records my self-review, not an automatic assessment.
I preserved originals and inspected the exact cleanup inventory before deleting only this recorded practice workspace.
coverage: LPIC-1 v5.0 103.2/103.3/103.4/105.2 reinforcement; independent transfer. Self-reviewed and unscored; no complete-objective, exam-readiness or LPI-endorsement claim.
